title: Rav Geviha of Argiza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Gittin 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.7a.10-12) Rav Huna bar Natan said to Rav Ashi, “What is the meaning of what is written?” — [Rav Huna bar Natan] said to him: “Rav Geviha of Argiza gave a reason for this: whoever has a grievance against his fellow and keeps silent, He who dwells forever executes judgment for him.” Rav Ashi said to him: “If so, Tziklag?” He [Rav Huna bar Natan] said to him: “If Rav Geviha of Bei Argiza were here, he would give a reason for it.” Hyman infers from this that he was a renowned preacher in Rav Ashi’s time.[^1]

notes.text: The linked text distinguishes Huna’s initial question, Ashi’s literal answer about cities, Huna’s report of Geviha’s interpretation and Ashi’s challenge. Hyman’s dash abbreviates the first exchange. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=827&lang=en) also cites this interpretation.
